text_elements.text: Get the detailed information from the customer about the symptom (the condition and the environment when the incident/malfunction occurred) using the 'Question sheet'. (Refer to EVB-83, "Diagnostic Work Sheet".)
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Check related service bulletins for information.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: YES >> Check the DTC. Refer to EVC-102, "DTC Index".
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Perform the following procedure if DTC is displayed.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: -Record DTC and freeze frame data. (Print them out with CONSULT.)
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: -Study the relationship between the cause detected by DTC and the symptom described by the customer. (Symptom Matrix Chart is useful. Refer to EVC-412, "Symptom Index".)
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check related service bulletins for information.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Are any symptoms described and any DTCs detected?
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Symptom is described, DTC is detected>>GO TO 4.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Symptom is described, DTC is not detected>>GO TO 5.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Symptom is not described, DTC is detected>>GO TO 6.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Try to confirm the symptom described by the customer.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Also study the normal operation and fail-safe related to the symptom. Refer to EVC-412, "Symptom Index" and EVB-40, "Fail-safe".
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Diagnosis Work Sheet is useful to verify the incident.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Verify relation between the symptom and the condition when the symptom is detected.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Try to confirm the symptom described by the customer.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Also study the normal operation and fail-safe related to the symptom. Refer to EVC-412, "Symptom Index" and EVB-40, "Fail-safe".
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Diagnosis Work Sheet is useful to verify the incident.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Verify relation between the symptom and the condition when the symptom is detected.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Perform DTC CONFIRMATION PROCEDURE for the displayed DTC, and then check that DTC is detected again.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Freeze frame data is useful if the DTC is not detected.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Perform  Component  Function  Check  if  DTC  CONFIRMATION  PROCEDURE is not included  on  Service Manual. This simplified check procedure is an effective alternative though DTC cannot be detected during this check.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: If the result of Component Function Check is NG, it is the same as the detection of DTC by DTC CONFIR- MATION PROCEDURE.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: NO >> Check according to GI-53, "Intermittent Incident".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Detect malfunctioning system according to EVC-412, "Symptom Index" based on the confirmed symptom in step 4, and determine the trouble diagnosis order based on possible causes and symptoms.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: NO >> Monitor input data from related sensors using CONSULT.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Inspect according to Diagnosis Procedure of the system.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: >> Monitor input data from related sensors using CONSULT.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Repair or replace the malfunctioning part.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Reconnect parts or connectors disconnected during Diagnosis Procedure again after repair and replace- ment.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check DTC. If DTC is displayed, erase it.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When DTC was detected in step 3, perform DTC CONFIRMATION PROCEDURE or Component Function Check again, and then check that the malfunction have been completely repaired.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: When symptom was described from the customer, refer to confirmed symptom in step 4 or 5, and check that the symptom is not detected.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Is DTC detected and does symptom remain?
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: YES-1 >> DTC is detected: GO TO 8.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: NO >> Before returning the vehicle to the customer, always erase DTC.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: There are many operating conditions that lead to the malfunction of 'EV battery system' components. A good grasp of such conditions can make troubleshooting faster and more accurate.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: In  general,  each  customer  feels  differently  about  symptoms.  It  is important to fully understand the symptoms or conditions for a cus- tomer complaint.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Utilize the diagnostic worksheet in order to organize all the informa- tion for troubleshooting.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Some conditions may cause a DTC to be detected.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text:  EV system warning lamp is on
text_elements.label: checkbox_unselected

text_elements.text:  Power limitation indicator lamp is on
text_elements.label: checkbox_unselected

text_elements.text:  Disappears when power switch is pushed OFF
text_elements.label: checkbox_unselected

text_elements.text:  Disappears when battery charge is stopped

text_elements.text: ADDITIONAL SERVICE WHEN REPLACING LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: ADDITIONAL SERVICE WHEN REPLACING LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: When a Li-ion Battery Controller (LBC) or Li-ion battery (battery pack) is replaced, it is necessary to save the battery information stored in LBC to the new LBC.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Whenever any of the following work is performed, make sure to perform the above operation.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Replace Li-ion battery (Battery pack: Module, LBC, Battery junction box)
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 1.SAVE THE LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER (LBC) INTERNAL INFORMATION
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Select 'SAVE BATTERY INFORMATION DATA' in 'WORK SUPPOTRT' mode.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Replace Li-ion battery or LBC. Refer to EVB-194, "Removal and Installation" (Li-ion battery) or EVB-214, "LI- ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation" (LBC).
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Select 'WRITE BATTERY INFORMATION DATA' in 'WORK SUPPOTRT' mode.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Write the information that has been read out before LBC replacement.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 4.WRITE THE LBC INTERNAL INFORMATION TO VCM
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Refer to 'Li-ion Battery Registration Operation Manual.
text_elements.label: text
